title: New Orleans Boat Cruise and Cajun Seafood Boil Experience
includes: Suggestions on nearby restaurants and bars with discounts
Alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks available for purchase (not included)
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Immerse yourself in the rich culinary heritage of New Orleans with a hands-on Cajun seafood boil experience. At your scenic marina on Bayou Bienvenue, we'll take you on a 1 hour nature tour explaining the local seafood culture and mechanics of the trade. Then, a master chef will guide you through the authentic techniques of boiling shrimp, crawfish, crabs, and more, sharing the stories and spices that define this beloved tradition. After mastering the art, gather around the table for a feast of perfectly seasoned seafood, corn, and potatoes, all while soaking up the vibrant culture of Louisiana. This unique culinary event is not just a lesson—it's a celebration of flavor and community.
